what.text: This page follows refugees from Cameroon living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4872 Cameroonian refugees in France, 3.5% of all refugees from Cameroon.
Nigeria hosts the most Cameroonian refugees, followed by Chad, the United States and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Ambazonia territory in Cameroon in every year from 2017 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Cameroon with JAS, and with the Islamic State group, in some years from 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 77 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
